description:
My mother raised twelve of us on one salary, no gadgets, no shortcuts — just knowing where the money leaks out of a house before it happens. She never called it a system. She called it not liking waste.

This channel is everything she taught me, plus what I've picked up over the years fixing appliances in other people's homes: how to make your refrigerator last twenty years, how to keep your house cool without touching the AC, how to keep mold out during the rainy season, and how to lower your electric bill without buying a single thing.

No products. No miracle boxes. Just the habits that worked before anyone thought to sell you a solution.
